WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, a.district_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        oc.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        oc.order_count,
        oc.order_count - AVG(oc.order_count) OVER () AS difference
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = oc.district_id
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference
FROM ranked
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
